title: The Workout plans page has no screen test at all
what: No browser test opens Workout plans. Making a plan, sending one to a member, Undo, workout of the day, edit, copy, withdraw and the Pro page are only checked as helper rules and server answers. A broken sheet or button would still pass every test.
expected: A browser test drives the page as owner and as desk: make and send a plan, send one to a member and undo, set and take off the workout of the day, withdraw a plan, and see the Pro page with the switch off.
fix_line: Add one browser test that drives the Workout plans page end to end

title: The set-up test expects "Next step" to go back to an earlier step
what: The journey says "Next step" must never loop back to the first step, and shows "This is the last step on the list." at the end. The helper test asserts the opposite: from the last step it goes back to an earlier step left undone. Either the journey or the test is wrong, and no screen test checks the last-step line.
expected: One agreed rule, written in both the journey and the test, and a screen test of the last step.
fix_line: Agree the rule, then fix the journey or the test and add a screen check

title: Three ways into Members are never opened in a test
what: No test opens /members/new and checks that the Add member sheet is open, no test opens a wrong member address and checks "Member not found" with "Back to members", and no test checks the "Joined in the app" tab subtitle, its empty words or the hidden Add button. A Today tile is only checked as a helper count.
expected: A browser test opens each of these addresses and checks the sheet, the not-found card and the app tab, and taps a Today tile and counts the rows.
fix_line: Add a browser test of the three Members addresses and one tile

title: Restoring an archived member is never tested
what: Tests archive a member and see "Restore member", but no test taps it. Nothing checks the member comes back to the list with the same plan, end date and dues, or that the count goes up again.
expected: A browser test archives, restores, and checks the list, count, plan dates and dues are as before.
fix_line: Tap Restore member in the archive test and check what comes back

title: Taking back or cancelling a sent message is never tested
what: The tests see the "Take back" and "Cancel" buttons but never tap them. The "No member has the app yet" warning, the past-time block and the "Not yet" answer are not checked either. A take-back that leaves the message in members' inboxes would pass.
expected: A browser test takes back a sent message and cancels a timed one, sees "Taken back" and "Cancelled", and the server shows it gone for members.
fix_line: Tap Take back and Cancel in the messages tests and check the result

title: The desk opening the message writer by address is never tested
what: Tests check that the desk menu has no Messages & offers, but no test types /messages or /shop/messages as the desk. A slip that shows the writer to the desk would pass, though the server would refuse the send.
expected: A desk browser test opens /messages and sees "Only an owner can see this", and /shop/messages lands on Shop.
fix_line: Add the two typed addresses to the desk test

title: Receipt not found and the date and amount error words are never tested
what: No test opens a wrong receipt id, or a receipt of another gym, and checks "Receipt not found" with "Back to Money". The collect sheet words "Pick the date you got this money.", "That date looks wrong. Check the year." and "That amount looks wrong. Type it again." are never checked.
expected: A browser test opens a wrong receipt address and types an empty date, a wrong year and a bad amount, and sees each plain message.
fix_line: Add the wrong receipt address and the three error words to the money test

title: Parts of cancelling a receipt are never tested
what: The too-short reason message, "Keep it", "Cancelling…", and the note for a cancelled membership ("nothing is added back to their dues") are not checked.
expected: The cancel-receipt test also types a two-letter reason, taps Keep it, and cancels a receipt of a cancelled membership.
fix_line: Add the short reason, Keep it and cancelled-membership cases

title: The plan form's error words and the starter price list are never tested
what: No test types a bad length, price, joining fee or extra days and checks "Duration must be a whole number between 1 and 120.", "The price looks wrong. Type it again." or "Days must be a whole number from 1 to 365.". No test taps "Use a starter price list" or checks it gives five plans once on a double tap.
expected: A browser test types each bad value and sees the words, and taps the starter list twice and counts five plans.
fix_line: Add the bad values and the starter list to the plans test

title: The desk's renew and its blocked plan actions are never tested
what: No test signs in as the desk and renews a plan, checks "No plans yet" with "Ask your gym owner to add the plans you sell.", refuses a back-dated sale, or checks that a cancelled membership has no "Undo cancel" and that "Only the owner can extend it." shows for a PT pack.
expected: The desk browser test renews a plan, tries a back-dated sale, and checks the owner-only buttons are absent.
fix_line: Add renew, back-dated sale and no-undo checks to the desk test

title: The Member app tab and the desk's own Settings page are never checked
what: No test checks the "Member app" tab (the join code, "Your look in the app", Challenges) or that back returns to the same tab. For the desk, only the absence of two demo buttons is checked: not the subtitle, the cards it does get, the missing backup and gym details, or that its theme choice is kept.
expected: A browser test opens the Member app tab, and a desk test checks its Settings cards and that no backup, records count or gym details show.
fix_line: Add the Member app tab and the desk Settings page to the settings test

title: Several desk paths on Today and the frame are never tested
what: No test as the desk taps a Today quick-action or a "Message" button, confirms a waiting number or a plan request from Today, or checks that a role change by the owner opens Expenses for that person without a stale block. No test checks the member page hides gym totals from the desk.
expected: A desk browser test taps a Today quick action and a Message button, handles one waiting line, and is promoted to owner and sees Expenses open.
fix_line: Add the desk Today actions and a role change to the desk test
